_doc: A DRAFT, NOT A SIGNATURE (the chair's ruling at point 36, ODQ-934.105 draft: the lane drafts ONE record, learns predictedRows at its own tip without running a golden door, leaves `seat` and the merge commit to the merge seat). COHERENCE-POWERS' cause is ONE: the owner's dual-hat law, the leader comes from a house of the town, and the powers stand on the houses (the charter docs/chair/2026-11-11/CHARTERS-COHERENCE-2026-11-11.md §0 and §5). Its component commits are listed in `cause`. They move the cast of every birth where a house leads (one fewer card: the office face), the ranks and importance of the ruling three, the roster where a power has no house (the fold, not built), the government where a council of a kind has no house of its kind, and the hall's capture state where no criminal power stands. predictedRows are the counts the failing golden assertions reported at the lane's tip (first seat 9a88668dd: 493 and 648; re-read by the second seat at 74b3b4949 and unchanged at c600ab68c: 519 and 782, the rise is PRESUME's final tip merged in, 1981a999d) (the golden master's differing configs, the manifest's moved rows); a hash-only surface reads 0. The goldens stay red at the lane's tip as the merge seat's named act.
